date.description: A step boundary: the horizon's start advanced by a whole number of steps. The point counts the horizon's flows dated before it, not one dated on it.

end.description: The end of the period, exclusive: the first date after it. For a calendar month, the first day of the next month. Must come after start.

start.description: The first date in the period, inclusive.

date.description: The step boundary it is measured on: the date of the matching point in both projections.

from.description: The horizon's start, inclusive, and the date of its first point.

to.description: The horizon's end and the date of its last point. Exclusive for flows: one dated on it is not counted.

on.description: The date of the cancellation. For a committed plan, it may not be before the commitment.

startsOn.description: The date of the first occurrence; every later one is counted from it.

on.description: The date the plan reached this status; absent while it is planned.
The date the plan was committed or realised, sent because no server reads a clock. Realising may not be dated before the commitment.

startsOn.description: The date of the first occurrence; every later one is counted from it.

instance.description: The request's path as received by the service that answered. Behind the gateway it omits the gateway's /ledger or /assistant prefix.

firstShortfall.description: The date of the first point at which projected cash is negative; absent when none is. Only points are checked, so a dip that recovers within one step is not reported.

occurredOn.description: The date the transaction occurred, which a listing's from and to select on. No lifecycle change may be dated before it.

until.description: UNTIL only. Exclusive: occurrences fall before it, never on it. Must come after startsOn.
UNTIL only. Exclusive: occurrences fall before it, never on it. Must come after startsOn.

occurredOn.description: The date the transaction occurred, which a listing's from and to select on.

on.description: The date the transaction reached this status; absent while it is pending.
The date the change took effect, sent because no server reads a clock. Clearing may not be dated before the transaction occurred, nor reconciling before it cleared.
The date of the void. It may not be before the transaction occurred, nor, for a cleared one, before it cleared.

parameters.description: The horizon's start, inclusive, and the date of its first point. That point is the opening position, before any flow or growth.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: The horizon's end and the date of its last point. Exclusive for flows: one dated on it is not counted. It must fall a whole number of steps after from, and at most 100 years after it.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: The spacing of the points: each is the horizon's start advanced by a whole number of steps.
parameters.name: step
